# Greener-Dalii · 格润达理

> Intelligence is no longer scarce. Leverage is the new company.
> 智力不再稀缺。杠杆才是新的公司。

## About

Greener-Dalii (格润达理) turns what you know into leverage. We are a small team with company-scale reach — everything open source, every number public, running on our own stack.

## Products

- Karpathy LLM Wiki: An Obsidian plugin that turns your notes into a connected, queryable knowledge base — every answer cites its source, local-first, no backend.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/obsidian-llm-wiki (repo)
  - https://llmwiki.greenerai.top (official site)
  - https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/karpathywiki (marketplace)
- Shift-Router: Task-level router for coding agents. Every turn is triaged into one of two configured model tiers — instant upgrades, trend-based downgrades, cache-aware routing, same-turn failover on rate limits; on complex tasks the strong tier orchestrates like a CTO, delegating implementation to fast subagents. One brand, two hosts:
  - Pi: https://github.com/green-dalii/pi-shift-router · https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-shift-router
  - DeepSeek Harness: https://github.com/green-dalii/dsh-shift-router
  - Official site: https://shiftrouter.greenerai.top
